//: JSON cannot contain comments, so npm ignores any key named "//" and we use it for notes.
This file is the project record card: name, version, description, commands and packages used.
scripts: shortcuts. Run with `npm run <name>` (in PowerShell: `npm.cmd run <name>`).
check     = list files whose formatting Prettier would tidy (changes nothing)
format    = tidy the formatting of every file
site      = show the website at http://localhost:5173
server    = run the server at http://localhost:8787 (reads secrets from .env)
db:local  = create the database tables on this computer (once)
db:online = create the database tables on Cloudflare (once)
deploy    = put the server online on Cloudflare
devDependencies: packages used only while building, never sent to visitors.
prettier = tidies code formatting; wrangler = Cloudflare tool that runs and uploads the server
^ before a version = that version or any newer one with the same first number.
private: true stops the project from being published to npm by accident.
name: my-page
